summary: Aico logins for the owner and agents

help: Logins: private files, metadata-only list/show, hidden-input set/rotate, scoped run, file-only get, grants, confirmed owner removal, coordinator lab assignments and scoped lab refs/enroll/refresh/run. Use aico logins --help for syntax. Never pass a value in arguments or print a real value.

usage.when: put and use logins from the Aico secrets folder; values via hidden input or stdin, lab values via fd handoff only
precautions: Never put values in argv, logs or tool output.

Hunters use test logins a coordinator gives them; a missing one is asked of their coordinator, never the owner. The owner's real accounts stay closed to them unless the owner marked that login hunters OK.

On a saved site login, other agents fix access, login page, notes and site name themselves (st logins allow/edit, logged); only username and password are the owner's. Backup keys, API keys, passwords and tool logins stay the owner's. Ask the owner only for a wrong or missing username or password, or a key that doesn't exist yet.
